'''Rumitar Shay''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[First Order officer|officer]] who served in the [[First Order military|military branch]] of the [[First Order]]. Holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[Petty Officer]] within [[Scan-Ops]], he worked on the [[Mega-class Star Dreadnought|''Mega''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Supremacy]]''—[[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]]'s [[flagship]] and [[Capital|headquarters]] of the First Order. Despite his rank, he was very young and was technically a [[junior officer]], due to the various members of the First Order being trained for direct combat since [[Reproduction|birth]].<ref name="TLJ:TVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rumitar Shay was played by British actor [[Akshay Kumar]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']].<ref>{{Twitter|Akshay04Kumar|status/946669034916995073|[[Akshay Kumar]]|quote=If, like me, y'all have been wondering just how Finn and Rose sneaked passed the bad guy's {{C|sic}} security systems so easily...BLAME THIS GUY! 👇👇👇 What an idiot. 🤦🏻‍♂️|archiveurl=https://archive.is/0INKj}}</ref> In the film's credits, the character is listed as Mega-Destroyer First Order Monitor.
